<thought>The search for templates that break a ketone (functional group name “ketones”) returned several candidates, but none of the returned mapped reactions clearly show a ketone being reduced to an alkane (the Wolff‑Kishner reduction). To find the correct template, I will broaden the search to retrieve more candidates and then look for a mapped reaction where the product is an alkane and the reactant contains a carbonyl (C=O) group. Once such a template is identified, I will extract its mapped_rxn and template_id for the final answer.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 20
}
</action_input>
